Made to Your Wall

Every mirror is cut to spec, not picked off a shelf.

Send us your wall's dimensions and the shape you like. Our cutting drawings are dialled in to the millimetre before glass ever touches the machine — so what arrives is what you measured.

SizingCustom width & height, any tolerance
LED toneWarm white · Cool white · Tri-colour touch
Frame finishRose gold, black, brushed brass, frameless
Lead timeShared once your drawing is confirmed

Why LyteMirror

The details that don't show up in a photo.

Edge-lit, not surface-lit

LED strips sit inside the frame edge, so the glow wraps the glass evenly instead of casting hot spots across your reflection.

Touch-sensor dimming

A single tap point on the glass controls brightness and colour temperature — no external switch to mount or wire.

Drawing before delivery

You approve the exact cutting drawing — shape, dimensions, and mounting points — before we cut the glass.

Get Started

Tell us your wall size — we'll draw the mirror.
